title: Niagara City Cruises
gap: Duration of each cruise not stated
blurb: Niagara City Cruises offers boat tours departing from Niagara Gorge to experience Niagara Falls surrounded by mist and energy. Guests can choose from daytime and nighttime cruises, including a Falls Fireworks Cruise. The cruises provide spectacular views and a close encounter with the natural wonder of Niagara Falls.
